# C386 (inline) — trade-day context as calendar infrastructure
User 2026-10-21: calendar time must be infrastructure, updated daily (today/tomorrow/yesterday). New src/engine_core/trade_day_context.py (build/refresh/load/check; persisted trade_calendar/day_context.json, recomputed when day or calendar version differs; prev/prev2/next/next2 trade dates + natural yesterday/tomorrow with trading flag). Wired: boot_trade_day writes it, calendar_refresh handler writes it, new event calendar_refresh_0005 (midnight roll), startup._calendar, slices/prep_trade_day/fetch_auction_item/auction_baseline/commands/core_guardian night_report/run_data_jobs route previous-day through it; guard test forbids new direct derivations. Tests use real calendar copies; contract test now blocks real SMTP (a failing run sent one real alert mail to 412826313@qq.com at 15:33 — disclosed to user).
